plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 9th house: they bring seriousness to your beliefs and growth; depth and rigor, or limiting what you explore. Failure mode: feeling your horizons narrowed. Take the discipline; keep your freedom to question.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
